effectSize: Each additional weekly set associated with a small increase in hypertrophic effect size
limitations: Diminishing returns not fully modelled here
title: Dose-response relationship between weekly resistance training volume and increases in muscle mass

keyFinding.enGB: Higher weekly resistance-training set volume is associated with greater hypertrophy on average, with a graded dose–response.
keyFinding.uk: Більший тижневий обсяг підходів силових тренувань у середньому пов’язаний із більшою гіпертрофією, з градованою дозовою відповіддю.

evidenceGrade.rationale: Meta-analysis of RT trials; heterogeneity and set-counting definitions limit certainty.
